sentences.english: My name is Tom.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字叫汤姆。

sentences.english: I can't remember her name, but she was very nice.
sentences.chinese: 我记不起她的名字了，但她人很好。

sentences.english: When I was in line for coffee, the barista asked for my name, and I almost said my brother's name by accident because I was so tired.
sentences.chinese: 我排队买咖啡的时候，咖啡师问我的名字，我累得差点说成我哥哥的名字。
sentences.scene: 在咖啡店点单时发生的小插曲

chinese_meaning: 友好的；令人愉快的；好看的

sentences.english: That's a nice shirt.
sentences.chinese: 那件衬衫很好看。
sentences.scene: 朋友之间互相夸奖衣着

sentences.english: Everyone at the party was really nice to me.
sentences.chinese: 派对上的每个人都对我非常友好。

sentences.english: I was nervous about the first day, but my new coworkers turned out to be super nice and even invited me to grab lunch with them.
sentences.chinese: 我第一天很紧张，但新同事们特别友好，还邀请我和他们一起去吃午饭。
sentences.scene: 新人第一天上班的体验

sentences.english: My right ear hurts a little.
sentences.chinese: 我的右耳有点疼。

sentences.english: Can you speak into my left ear? I can't hear well on the other side.
sentences.chinese: 你能对着我的左耳说吗？我另一只耳朵听不太清。

sentences.english: I tried to clean my ear with a cotton swab, but then it felt blocked, so I made an appointment to get my ears checked.
sentences.chinese: 我试着用棉签清理耳朵，结果感觉堵住了，就预约去检查耳朵。
sentences.scene: 生活中耳朵不适去看医生

sentences.english: Wash your hands before dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭前要洗手。
sentences.scene: 家长提醒孩子饭前洗手

sentences.english: He held my hand while we walked through the crowd.
sentences.chinese: 我们穿过人群的时候他牵着我的手。

sentences.english: I burned my hand a little while taking the pan out of the oven, so I ran it under cold water for a few minutes and now it feels better.
sentences.chinese: 我把烤盘从烤箱拿出来时手稍微烫了一下，赶紧用冷水冲了几分钟，现在好多了。

sentences.english: Close your eyes and make a wish.
sentences.chinese: 闭上眼睛许个愿。

sentences.english: Something got into my eye. Can you see if there's anything?
sentences.chinese: 我眼睛里进东西了，你能帮我看看吗？

sentences.english: I rubbed my eyes so hard because of allergies that they turned red, and my friend jokingly asked if I'd been crying.
sentences.chinese: 过敏让我使劲揉眼睛，结果眼睛都红了，朋友开玩笑问我是不是刚哭过。

sentences.english: Don't talk with your mouth full.
sentences.chinese: 嘴里塞满东西时不要说话。

sentences.english: The food was so spicy that my whole mouth was burning.
sentences.chinese: 那个食物太辣了，辣得我整个嘴像着了火一样。
sentences.scene: 吃到超辣食物后的反应

sentences.english: I woke up with a weird taste in my mouth and realized I'd forgotten to brush my teeth the night before after that late-night snack.
sentences.chinese: 我醒来时嘴里有股怪味，才意识到昨晚吃了夜宵后忘了刷牙。

sentences.english: My arm is sore from the shot.
sentences.chinese: 我打针的那只手臂酸痛。
sentences.scene: 打完疫苗后跟朋友说明情况

sentences.english: I fell off my bike and scraped my arm, but it's not too bad.
sentences.chinese: 我从自行车上摔下来擦伤了手臂，不过不太严重。

sentences.english: She grabbed my arm and pulled me back just before I stepped into the street without looking, and I was so grateful she was paying attention.
sentences.chinese: 我过马路没看车就要迈步，她一把抓住我的胳膊把我拉回来，我特别感激她留意到了。
sentences.scene: 朋友及时阻止危险发生

sentences.english: I can swim.
sentences.chinese: 我会游泳。
sentences.scene: 告诉别人自己会的技能

sentences.english: Can you pick up some milk on your way home?
sentences.chinese: 你回家的路上能买点牛奶吗？

sentences.english: I can’t believe I left my keys inside again, but luckily my roommate can come back early to let me in.
sentences.chinese: 我简直不敢相信又把钥匙落在屋里了，不过好在室友可以早点回来给我开门。

sentences.english: Let's share the cake.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起吃这块蛋糕吧。

sentences.english: Do you want to share a ride to the airport tomorrow?
sentences.chinese: 明天你愿意一起拼车去机场吗？

sentences.english: During the meeting, she shared a story about how she solved the same problem at her last job, and it really helped everyone calm down.
sentences.chinese: 会上她分享了自己上一份工作时如何解决类似问题的经历，真的让大家都镇定下来了。
sentences.scene: 工作会议上同事分享经验

sentences.english: You have a beautiful smile.
sentences.chinese: 你的笑容很美。

sentences.english: Every time I see her, she smiles and says hello.
sentences.chinese: 我每次见到她，她都会微笑着打招呼。
sentences.scene: 描述一位友善的邻居或同事

sentences.english: I was having a really tough morning, but when the barista smiled and remembered my order, it completely turned my day around.
sentences.chinese: 我今天上午本来特别难熬，但咖啡师微笑着还记下了我的点单，那一刻我的心情完全变好了。
sentences.scene: 咖啡馆里陌生人的善意

sentences.english: Listen to me, please.
sentences.chinese: 请听我说。
sentences.scene: 希望引起对方注意认真听

sentences.english: I love listening to music while I cook dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢做晚饭时听音乐。

sentences.english: I wish I had listened to my mom when she told me to bring an umbrella, because now I'm completely soaked walking home in the rain.
sentences.chinese: 我真希望当初听了妈妈的话带上雨伞，现在只能淋着雨走回家，浑身都湿透了。

sentences.english: Can I help you?
sentences.chinese: 需要帮忙吗？

sentences.english: Thanks for helping me move the couch. I couldn't do it alone.
sentences.chinese: 谢谢你帮我搬沙发，我一个人搬不动。
sentences.scene: 朋友帮忙搬家或挪家具

sentences.english: When my car broke down, a stranger stopped to help, and we ended up waiting together for the tow truck and talking about our dogs.
sentences.chinese: 我车抛锚时，一位陌生人停下来帮忙，最后我们一起等拖车，还聊了聊彼此养的狗。

sentences.english: What did you say?
sentences.chinese: 你刚说什么？

sentences.english: She didn't say goodbye before she left, which was a little strange.
sentences.chinese: 她走之前没说再见，这有点奇怪。
sentences.scene: 留意到朋友的反常行为

sentences.english: I wanted to say thank you for the gift, but I got shy and just smiled, so I sent a text message later to say how much I loved it.
sentences.chinese: 我本来想当面谢谢你的礼物，但害羞得只笑了笑，后来发了条短信说我很喜欢。
sentences.scene: 当面表达感谢有点尴尬转而用文字

sentences.english: She is my best friend.
sentences.chinese: 她是我最好的朋友。
sentences.scene: 向别人介绍闺蜜或死党

sentences.english: I'm meeting an old friend for coffee this afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 我今天下午约了一位老朋友喝咖啡。

sentences.english: A true friend isn't someone who just hangs out with you when things are fun, but someone who shows up when you really need support.
sentences.chinese: 真正的朋友不是只在好玩的时候陪你玩的人，而是在你真正需要支持时出现的人。
sentences.scene: 经历困难后对友情的感悟

sentences.english: This pizza is so good.
sentences.chinese: 这个比萨太好吃了。
sentences.scene: 吃到喜欢的食物时赞叹

sentences.english: She's really good at explaining hard things in a simple way.
sentences.chinese: 她特别擅长用简单的方式解释难懂的东西。
sentences.scene: 夸奖朋友或同事的讲解能力

sentences.english: It was a good day—we didn't do anything special, just walked around the park and had ice cream, but it felt exactly right.
sentences.chinese: 那是一个美好的一天，我们没做什么特别的事，只是在公园逛逛、吃冰淇淋，但感觉恰到好处。
sentences.scene: 描述平淡但惬意的周末
